description: This file defines a PHP trait named EmployeeSalaryServiceTrait within the OrangeHRM project. It provides a method to retrieve an EmployeeSalaryService instance from a service container, utilizing dependency injection principles common in PHP applications. The trait itself is designed to be incorporated into classes that require access to the EmployeeSalaryService.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalaryService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeSalaryService from the service container.
